title: Evidence Record
description: An evidence record states that a verification ran (type run) or that a person attests a node (type attestation), against one code tree. One record per file, spec/extras/verification/evd-<id>.json, written by the toolkit and never by hand. The file holds a records array of exactly one record, and the file name without .json is the record id. It carries no timestamp: the git author and commit date the record.

records.description: The one evidence record of this file.

items.description: An evidence record. A run names a verification record and holds the exit code, the guard result and the hash of the output; an attestation names the nodes a person attests and holds none of these.

evidence_id.description: Id of this record: evd- followed by a kebab-case name. Equals the file name without .json.

type.description: run: the commands of a verification record ran. attestation: a person states that the node holds. Default run.

about.description: Ids of what the record is about: for a run, the verification record it ran (one item); for an attestation, the nodes attested.

stage.description: Stage at which the run happened or the attestation was made: dev, ci, staging or prod. Default dev.

tested_tree.description: Id of the code tree the run or the attestation is about (a git tree id).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the run. A run only.

guard_matched.description: Whether the output of the run matched the output guard of the verification record. A run only.

output_hash.description: Hash of the output of the run: sha256: and 64 lower-case hex digits. Never a hash of this record. A run only.

installed_versions.description: Version of each third party the verified nodes rely on, as installed during the run: third-party node id to version string. A run only.
